title: Define Governance Program, Request, and Facts for the evaluation kernel
goal: Give the Governance kernel one unambiguous ubiquitous language for its three input categories while preserving CyberAlchemy authority, evidence, lifecycle, and effect boundaries.

candidate_mappings.current_proposition: The Program has designated stable identity and version continuity independent of its content digest and source Constitution lifecycle.
The Request is immutable content describing one proposed consequence; a separately identified Evaluation may record an attempt involving it.
The Fact is equal by its complete typed proposition, scope, validity, source, verifier, and provenance while supporting Evidence retains separate identity.
The Fact Set is the immutable bounded denominator supplied for one Program and Request, not a snapshot or hash of repository state.

open_questions: Which exact verifier contracts may admit each Governance Fact kind into a runtime evaluation?
Which system-runtime ontology owns the separately identified Governance Evaluation and its verdict record?
decision_owner: CyberAlchemy Governance runtime owner with CyberAlchemy authority and DomainSpec v2 definitions-governance review
